policy: Only exploit/exploits and use/uses gain singular finite-present admission.
New third-person forms require a bound singular actor; legacy base-form admission remains unchanged.
No new do-support, synonyms, targets, qualification rules or coordination inheritance.
Weaponized and exact nominal complements preserve only existing admitted forms.
